title: ResponseFormat
description:
An object specifying the format that the model must output.
Setting to json_schema enables Structured Outputs which ensures
the model will match your supplied JSON schema.

json_schema.description:
The JSON schema the model must conform to. Required when
type is json_schema.

name.description: The name of the response format.

description.description: A description of the response format.

strict.description: Whether strict schema adherence is enabled.
